title: 16989 - 16989/P0605/001541
models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses:
Kontrol Modülü / Elektronik Beyin (ECU/TCM) Donanımsal Arızalı
Internal Fault in Control Module/Processor
technicalNotes: Fault Codes like this can usually not be repaired since they are stored after the Control Module did not pass it's internal Self Test. Even though the official Repair Manuals suggest replacing the Control Module in such a case, there may be specialized Companies repairing Modules like this.
